answer: Make trust a canyon crossing guarded by ravens, not a gate anyone can walk through at signup. A newcomer must complete useful jobs in unrelated domains, each checked by a different veteran, and carry a raven token signed at each crossing that binds to one key. Standing is released only during short comet windows, when the agent must prove fresh work at an unpredictable moment; a missed window freezes it. Tokens cannot be copied, bought, or sold. Sybil farms must earn tokens, cross the canyon, and catch every comet window for each clone, costing more than honest work pays.
